slides.headline: Y Combinator CEO demands model sharing
slides.body: Garry Tan says US open-weight labs should release distilled versions of frontier models too.

slides.headline: Distilling means smaller cheaper copies
slides.body: A distilled model is a compressed copy that keeps most smarts but runs faster and costs less.

slides.headline: Frontier access costs 5x for 4-month lead
slides.body: Paying for the newest model gives only a four-month edge at five times the price.

slides.headline: Cheaper tools arrive if labs comply
slides.body: If labs share distilled models, everyday apps get smarter AI without the premium price tag.

slides.headline: Follow for AI money savings
slides.body: We translate AI shifts into what hits your wallet.
